title: Arena: Total War-inspired browser based game. 10v10 multiplayer battles with thousands of soldiers fighting in real time
author: eljimbobo

comments.author: eljimbobo
comments.body:
As a fan of Total War and MOBA games, Arena Total War was my dream game. I had so much fun playing it while it was still available, and so bummed when it was taken offline. While a group of modders are reviving the game unofficially, I wanted to take the basis of the game and make it more accessible to more people, while putting my own spin on it. 

I didn't like that players needed to unlock units with play or micro transactions, so every unit of every faction is available at the start of the game. 

I wanted there to be consistency between the armies, so all players on each team are all part of the same faction. 

I wanted to open up more opportunities beyond historically inspired generals and units, and draw from my love of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, so added a fantasy layer that created asymmetric factions each with distinct strengths and weaknesses. 

This is an early prototype, and my next steps are to set up a login system to track things ELO rankings. 

If you're interested in a game like this, I'd love to hear your feedback on what you would want to be included.
